title: Enterprise Factual Presentation Reconciliation
objective: Ensure factual intelligence supplied by an imported Twin survives the governed factual pipeline and is represented accurately in Enterprise executive views without being confused with assessment or recommendation.
implementation_summary: Extended the existing Canonical Factual Projection with a governed Enterprise dimension read contract.
Made Enterprise list, dossier and Advanced Inspection consume the same factual presence decisions.
Rendered structured candidate facts as human-readable values while preserving evidence, Unknowns, Contradictions and candidate governance.
expected_visible_outcomes: Supplied Enterprise facts are visible and are not hidden behind pending assessment.
Structured facts render human-readably; genuinely missing facts remain visibly missing.
Diagnostics and executive pages agree; Programme and Opportunity associations remain working.
unchanged_areas: Protected: 308 Relationship candidates; working Enterprise identity lineage and associations; 13 Programmes; 17 Opportunities; factual dimension isolation; candidate governance.
required_test_steps: Open Import Twin, Explore Twin and Advanced Inspection.
Open all six TEL-001 Enterprise dossiers and inspect every factual dimension.
Confirm factual content remains visible with assessment not yet performed and no raw dictionaries render.
Confirm 308 Relationships, 13 Programmes, 17 Opportunities and exact Enterprise associations remain reconciled.
fresh_import_policy: No fresh import is required: source and candidate factual objects are already retained; only the shared read/projection and presentation owners changed.
known_limitations: Enterprise Economics and Leadership / Governance are architectural intent not implemented as independent TEL-001 runtime dimensions.
Industry/domain remains Not established because TEL-001 Enterprise candidates carry no explicit semantic domain and Twin membership is not treated as proof.

automated_validation.known_failing_tests: None in focused population/relationship acceptance suite.

operator_validation_status: PASS — exact association sets and rendered routes reconciled
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
fresh_import_required: No — retained candidate/source data is sufficient.
